description: Bookmarks structural guardrails for Flutter-compatible design SSOT aligned with browsing-history chrome.

forbiddenSelectors.message: Bookmarks must not inherit browsing-history retry/bulk-delete FAB behavior.
Bookmarks render saved snapshots directly; row-level recovery controls are forbidden.
External Material Symbols font usage is forbidden in this HTML design repository.
Disease bookmark rows must mirror disease result cards and must not render an image tile.
Legacy bookmark-only row markup must not return; use shared .hrow result-card markup.
Legacy bookmark top-panel chrome must not return; use browsing-history fixed tab/search chrome.
Counts do not belong in the shared AppTabHeader appbar.
Loading state does not belong in the shared AppTabHeader appbar.
Do not render id-prefix type badges as visible card badges.
Do not render id-prefix type badges as visible card badges.
Bottom navigation must use the same SVG icon treatment as browsing-history.
Preview panes are not part of the bookmarks screen contract.
Bookmarks are always ordered by bookmarkedAt DESC and do not expose a sort bar.
Tabs must be fixed outside the scroll area.
Keyword search must be fixed outside the scroll area.

requiredSelectors.message: The forbidden-patterns section must remain documented.
Bookmarks SSOT must include the retained device/theme/state frame matrix.
iPhone compact frames must cover all retained states plus Dynamic Type.
iPhone landscape light/dark evidence is required for retained states.
iPad portrait light/dark evidence is required for retained states.
iPad landscape light/dark evidence is required for retained states.
iPad Split 50:50 evidence must include normal and search-zero in both themes.
Every retained frame state must have dark-mode evidence.
Dynamic Type 200% evidence must include light and dark frames.
Empty state must be represented.
Search zero-result state must be represented.
Saved-data read/decode error state must be represented.
Initial loading skeleton rows must be represented as shimmer rows.
Swipe delete reveal must be represented using browsing-history style.
Drug bookmark rows must carry id prefix, type, timestamp, and snapshot kind.
Disease bookmark rows must carry id prefix, type, timestamp, and snapshot kind.
Phone portrait must keep tabs fixed outside scroll.
Phone portrait must keep keyword search fixed outside scroll.
Phone portrait must keep only content in the scrollable area.
iPhone landscape pane layout must place keyword search above vertical tabs.
iPhone landscape pane layout must keep vertical tabs in the left pane.
iPad portrait pane layout must place keyword search above vertical tabs.
iPad portrait pane layout must keep vertical tabs in the left pane.
iPad landscape pane layout must place keyword search above vertical tabs.
iPad landscape pane layout must keep vertical tabs in the left pane.
Split-view pane layout must place keyword search above vertical tabs.
Split-view pane layout must keep vertical tabs in the left pane.
Disclaimer ribbon must be present in every retained frame.
Bottom navigation selected destination must use the shared icon + selected pill treatment.

forbiddenDescendants.message: Disease bookmark rows must not render drug-style image tiles.
